countdown.purpose: Live-reveal timer; the one intentionally large element, set in mono to read as a machine-timed instrument.

winner-name.purpose: Display-scale winner list on the live reveal; the single moment of warmth.

page-title.purpose: Panel h1 on Draw, Verify, How-it-works.

mono.purpose: Hashes, randomness, record JSON, plus the live-reveal countdown and winner-rank markers.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Resting panels and the primary button.

motion.name: control-transition

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call to action on a screen (Run draw, Verify, Load).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-primary, #4f46e5); color: var(--color-on-primary, #fff); font: 500 0.875rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 41 / .04), 0 1px 3px rgb(15 23 41 / .06); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #4338ca); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #4f46e5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #cdd3dd); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0f1729); font: 500 0.875rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-sunken, #f2f4f7); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #4f46e5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Control (text input)
components.description: Standard field used for inputs and textareas.
components.css: .ds-control { width: 100%; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #cdd3dd); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0f1729); font: 400 0.875rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-control::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #55607a); } .ds-control:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-primary, #4f46e5); outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #4f46e5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The single container that frames each task.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e2e6ec); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 41 / .04), 0 1px 3px rgb(15 23 41 / .06); } .ds-panel h1 { margin: 0; font: 600 1rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #0f1729); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Per-check result badge and headline verification pill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.375rem; height: 1.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; font: 700 0.75rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1; } .ds-chip-ok { background: var(--color-ok-bg, #ecfdf5); color: var(--color-ok, #047857); }

components.name: Nav Tab
components.description: Top navigation tab; active tab carries an indigo underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.125rem; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--color-muted, #55607a); font: 400 0.875rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #0f1729); } .ds-nav-tab-active { border-color: var(--color-primary, #4f46e5); color: var(--color-ink, #0f1729); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: GlassPick looks like a precision instrument, not a game of chance. The system serves a task that lives or dies on trust, so the interface is quiet, legible, and deliberately unremarkable: a single indigo accent on a cool near-white field, one typeface family, panels with soft borders and the faintest lift. Nothing competes with the numbers, hashes, and rules that make a draw provable. It rejects every visual cue of gambling and lottery products and the generic AI-tool palette; restraint is the brand. The one place the system permits warmth is the winner reveal.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (indigo), used only for actions, selection, and state, never decoration.
One typeface family; a monospace face reserved for cryptographic data.
Cool, tinted neutrals on a near-white field; a matching dark theme.
Soft-bordered panels with a whisper of elevation; flat by default.
Familiar, standard controls; density where the task needs it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only non-semantic colour: primary actions, active tab, focus rings, brand mark, nowhere else.

rules.name: The Both-Themes Rule
rules.body: Every colour is defined for light and dark. Never ship a token or surface that only works in one theme.

rules.name: The Legible-Fill Rule
rules.body: Text on a saturated fill uses the on-primary token, never hard-coded #fff; it flips to near-black in dark mode so the primary button clears WCAG AA. Verify new coloured fills in both themes.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: UI type sizes are a fixed rem scale, not fluid clamps. Fluid sizing is only for the two reveal-screen headings.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Proof Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for cryptographic and record data. Never use it for prose or labels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and separated by tint and 1px lines. Never exceed the two defined shadow values.

dos: Do keep indigo (#4f46e5) as the sole accent: actions, selection, focus, brand mark.
Do define every new colour and component for both light and dark themes.
Do use the fixed rem type scale for UI; reserve fluid sizing for the two reveal headings.
Do render hashes, randomness, and records in the monospace face.
Do keep interactive targets at at least 2.75rem and preserve the 2px indigo focus outline.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion, including suppressing the reveal confetti.
Do state plainly what a draw proves and what it does not, at the point of action.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, or use saturated colour on inactive states.
Don't use gambling or lottery cues: coin-gold, spinning wheels, slot-machine framing, or manufactured suspense.
Don't reach for generic AI-tool patterns: hero-metric templates, identical icon-heading-text card grids, gradient text, or glassmorphism.
Don't use coloured side-stripe borders on notices or cards; use full borders and semantic backgrounds.
Don't nest cards, or exceed the two defined shadow values.
Don't use the monospace face for prose or labels, or display-scale headings for ordinary UI.
Don't imply guarantees GlassPick does not make (eligibility, list completeness, legal compliance).
